name.zh: Garry's Mod 插件修复任务

description.en: Multi-defect repair tasks built from real open-source Garry's Mod addons: each starter is an upstream tree with several real upstream fixes reverted, evaluated against a real headless Garry's Mod dedicated server running GLuaTest. Every task reports only user-visible symptoms and never states how many defects there are.
description.zh: 基于真实开源 Garry's Mod 插件构建的多缺陷修复任务：每个初始代码都是回退了若干真实上游修复的上游代码树，在运行 GLuaTest 的真实无头 Garry's Mod 专用服务器中评测。每道题只给出用户可见的现象，且不告知缺陷数量。

title.en: Advanced Duplicator 2: reports from a building server
title.zh: Advanced Duplicator 2：来自建造服务器的问题报告

summary.en: Diagnose and repair every reported problem in the Advanced Duplicator 2 addon.
summary.zh: 诊断并修复 Advanced Duplicator 2 插件中报告的全部问题。

brief.en: Diagnose and repair every reported problem in the Advanced Duplicator 2 addon.
brief.zh: 诊断并修复 Advanced Duplicator 2 插件中报告的全部问题。

en: Fix the underlying causes rather than suppressing the symptoms.
Preserve the behaviour of every code path that already works.
zh: 修复根本原因，而不是掩盖现象。
保持所有已经正常的代码路径的既有行为。

en: Use the addon's own code and the Garry's Mod APIs already present in the tree.
zh: 使用插件自身的代码以及代码树中已有的 Garry's Mod API。

en: Every private GLuaTest assertion must pass on a headless server without network access.
zh: 所有私有 GLuaTest 断言必须在无网络的无头服务器中通过。
